meta.counting_semantics: Each trial is counted once per bucket. Legs are overlapping populations: 290 trial memberships are shared between legs, so series totals overlap.
assumptions: Interpreted 'involving pembrolizumab vs nivolumab' as comparing trials filtered by intervention_names/search intervention for each named drug.
Interpreted 'Compare phases' as trial counts grouped by the categorical field phases.

warnings: 'Not Applicable' and 'Not Reported' together are roughly 63% of the registry. Combination phases (e.g. Phase 1/Phase 2) form their own bucket and are never double-counted into Phase 1 and Phase 2, so these totals will not match ClinicalTrials.gov's own phase facets, which do double-count.
290 trial membership(s) are shared between legs; the compared populations overlap and do not sum to a distinct total.

21 contribution(s) carry no citation because the record does not state the value anywhere quotable — an absent field reported as its own bucket has nothing to quote, and a leg whose term the registry matched through a synonym is not repeated in the record. Nothing is cited that the record does not say.
